name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio: Ricardo's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. After a decade in law enforcement in Buenos Aires, a chance encounter with a racing team owner led to a role managing trackside security. He quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a keen eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to safety. He believes a proactive approach, coupled with strong communication, is key to preventing incidents before they occur. Ricardo is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to build trust with drivers and team personnel alike.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples
physical.description: Ricardo is a powerfully built man with a stern but fair face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in casual settings.
Insists on walking the entire paddock perimeter every morning before races.
Has a superstitious habit of tapping his badge three times before entering the garage.
